body:
New sip/rtp.prn: parse-rtp-header/build-rtp-header, RFC 3550 fixed 12-byte header codec, pure PARENA no FFI. Found 2 real bugs: string/length is literally strlen (truncates on embedded 0x00, fixed via explicit len param); string/concat is strcpy/strcat (same truncation on write side, honestly documented as a real, unfixed limitation, out of scope). make test-rtp 6/6, make test 345/345. Commit e25fb3d.

⚓ ☃
title: Real, low-level RTP header primitives (kanban PBX-001)
